podcast.title: Jonathan Davis's Background
podcast.body: Lead singer Jonathan Davis previously worked as an "apprentice mortician," with one of his old jobs involving picking up bodies at traffic accident scenes. "Led by an apprentice mortician named Jonathan Davis, one of his old jobs was to pick up bodies at traffic accidents scenes."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Lyrical Themes
podcast.body: Lyrically, the band focused on themes of "personal tragedy and angst and fear," and they were known for "turn[ing] everything up to 11." "Now, lyrically, the band was focused on personal tragedy and angst and fear. And then they turned everything up to 11."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Most Successful New Metal Band
podcast.body: Korn is considered "probably" the most successful of all the new metal bands. "The most successful of all the new metal bands is probably corn."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Musical Influences and Sound
podcast.body: Korn took what Rage Against the Machine was doing, incorporated a "healthy dose of grunge," and then mixed in elements of Cypress Hill, creating a distinctive sound. "Corn took what rage against the machine was doing, added in a healthy dose of grunge and then mixed in a bunch of Cypress Hill."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Origins in California Desert
podcast.body: The band emerged from the California desert in the early 1990s. "who came out of the California desert in the early 1990s."
